do_not_use_when: Exact reweighting from a stored amplitude set: use amplitude-predictions.
A closed-form formula over a grid: use formula-grid.

examples.phrase: Synthetic example: a cross section quadratic in two couplings from three runs plus one held-out run.

use_when: Fit a polynomial in couplings to cross sections or binned yields from several runs and check a held-out run.
A continuous coupling dependence must be interpolated with conditioning, closure and covariance.
